findings: The 3D isotropic linear dispersion makes integrated crystal momentum proportional to the angular energy first moment. Linearized local maximum-entropy normal collisions therefore preserve P0 and P1; resistive collisions preserve P0 only.
The orthonormal Legendre streaming recurrence, initial coefficient normalization, detector moments and negative-imaginary sine convention are consistent.

The completed Matthiessen isotropization shortcut uses both rates and conserves energy, but spuriously damps momentum during normal collisions. Uniform P2 calibration is exactly equivalent and identifies the resistive rate.
The independent angular-ordinate reference constructs the energy and momentum projections directly, without the oracle Legendre collision mask.
